HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.

9. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Care of the Home: Exterior Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Special Treatment in Laundry Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Ventilation and Lighting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
